key_insight: Mem++ preserves full document history and defers memory selection to read time, enabling LLM agents to answer time-sensitive organizational questions without losing earlier versions.
engineering_relevance: This is useful for long-horizon enterprise agents and knowledge systems that must track evolving decisions, provenance, and time-aware retrieval across document revisions.
method: Stores every document in full with timestamp and author metadata.
Performs no generative distillation at write time.
At query time, filters by the question’s time context and combines lexical plus semantic retrieval rankings.
evidence_signal: On OrgMemBench, Mem++ outperforms the strongest memory baseline by 8.0–13.1 points across two answering models, and with gpt-4.1-mini it leads overall by 2.6 points over RAG.
watch_item: Keeping all versions can increase storage and retrieval complexity, so robust time filtering and ranking are important to avoid irrelevant or stale context.
paper_title: Mem++: Non-Destructive Memory for Long-Term Organizational LLM Agents
